scope: Exploratory transport screen, not strategy confirmation
authorization: Nico: choose asset/timeframe and run several Kaggle analyses without L2; no protected reserves opened

families.MOM60: 60-minute close change >= prior ATR20; follow sign
families.VWAP2: Close >=2 prior ATR20 from RTH cumulative traded-volume VWAP; oppose sign
families.ORFAIL30: First close >=1 tick outside 09:30–10:00 ET range, then inside within30min; oppose breakout

decision: Completed-bar close, start >=10:00 ET and close <=13:45 ET
entry: First tick strictly after signal+250ms, within1s; observed bid/ask aggressive side
exit: First tick >=entry+2h, within1s; observed opposite bid/ask side
no_overlap: 7201s blocked per cell; ORFAIL first attempt only

partitions.internal_validation: Jan–Mar2026,60 sessions, only discovery survivors; not virgin nor holdout
partitions.closed: April onward; July holdout not decoded

population: Canonical prior-session contract catalog; complete RTH5/15min grid; max RTH interprint gap60s; technical entry/exit/quote failures censored and counted
budget: 6 cells, 2 primary endpoints each =12 Bonferroni one-sided bounds; no threshold search
endpoints: Signed midpoint change vs randomized direction at identical selected decision/exit times
inference: 20,000 session bootstrap seed20260930; minimum30trades and20active sessions; both adjusted lower bounds >0 to screen-pass; survivor validation multiplicity2*n
power: MDE80 normal approximation from clustered bootstrap SE; not certified prospective power
provenance: Compressed file hashes verified against AUDIT_MANIFEST and files.sha256. Original manifests carry pre-recompression hashes, recorded separately
brain_lessons: No rescue of saturated historical grids
Same as-of event times for directional control
limits: No actual fills or quote-age certification
